title: Argument and reasoning
note: To refute a claim is to prove it false; to rebut it is to answer it with counterargument. Many fallacies have names worth knowing: the ad hominem attacks the arguer, the straw man attacks a distorted version of the view, the red herring changes the subject, and the non sequitur draws a conclusion that does not follow.
